bio.text: Hillary Cassel, a Republican, represents District 101 in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Cassel was first elected in 2022.
Cassel is an attorney who lives in Dania Beach.

Cassel earned an associate degree from Tallahassee Community College, a bachelor's degree from Florida State University and a law degree from Nova Southeastern University's Shepard Broad Law School, and was born in Boynton Beach, Florida.
